top_findings.title: No MCP protocol implementation — plain Go library, not an MCP server
top_findings.evidence: grep for jsonrpc|stdio|RegisterTool|modelcontextprotocol|tools/list|tools/call across *.go = 0 hits (only the module name and a struct literally named MCPServer match 'mcp'). go.mod declares zero dependencies. server/server.go:12 MCPServer is a plain struct; main.go:37-48 constructs it and calls its methods directly. No transport, no tool registration, no tool schemas.
top_findings.suggestion: Add a JSON-RPC-over-stdio transport and register the query methods as MCP tools with input schemas, or hand-roll initialize/tools/list/tools/call handlers.

top_findings.title: Team statistics compute goals for/against incorrectly for away matches
top_findings.evidence: server/server.go:88-90 unconditionally does stats.GoalsFor += m.HomeGoals; stats.GoalsAgainst += m.AwayGoals for every match, so away goals-for/against are swapped. W/L/D counts (92-108) branch correctly. Siblings CalculateStandings (215-218) and GetHeadToHead (150-152) swap correctly, confirming a bug. TestGetTeamStatistics (main_test.go:150-186) never asserts goals.
top_findings.suggestion: When isAway, add m.AwayGoals to GoalsFor and m.HomeGoals to GoalsAgainst (mirror CalculateStandings), and add a test asserting away-match goals.
